summary: A single selectable image option inside a visual picker grid.
description: A single option within a moz-visual-picker. Visual appearance is determined by slotted content, or by the built-in label/description/imageSrc rendering.

attributes.name: checked
attributes.description: Whether or not the item is selected.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Whether or not the item is disabled.

attributes.name: itemTabIndex
attributes.description: Tabindex of the input element. Only one item is focusable at a time (roving tabindex).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the item, set by the associated moz-visual-picker parent element.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Visible label for the picker item.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Additional text shown beneath the label.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Native title tooltip. Mapped onto the inner shadow DOM item and removed from moz-visual-picker-item itself.

attributes.name: imageSrc
attributes.description: Path to an image to display in the picker item.

attributes.name: labelPosition
attributes.description: Position of the label: "inside" (default, rendered inside the picker item button) or "outside" (rendered as a clickable label element that activates the item).

slots.name: (default)
slots.description: The item's content, used for what gets displayed (e.g. a custom card or avatar).

events.name: click
events.description: Re-dispatched (bubbles, composed) from the internal button, including for Space/Enter keyboard activation.

events.name: input
events.description: Manually dispatched (bubbles, composed) on selection, since the item is not backed by a native input.

events.name: change
events.description: Manually dispatched (bubbles, composed) on selection, alongside input.

cssParts.name: image
cssParts.description: The item's own , rendered when imageSrc is set.
